WITH player_award_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award
    GROUP BY player_id
),
total_awards AS (
    SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count
    FROM player_award_counts
)
SELECT player_award_counts.player_id,
       player_award_counts.award_count,
       CAST(player_award_counts.award_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_awards.total_count, 0) AS fraction
FROM player_award_counts
CROSS JOIN total_awards
WHERE total_awards.total_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
